text: Assessing asset — reading measured spectra, modes and kinematics first.

Genset at 1,498 rpm from a 30 fps capture — shaft rate is above Nyquist and amplitudes are uncalibrated, so shaft-order faults aren't evaluable. Reporting findings on that basis, with no speed setpoint for this fixed-frequency machine.

title: Speed identified confidently, but shaft frequency exceeds video Nyquist
summary: Kinematics: genset, synchronous, 4-stroke. Speed posterior MAP 1497.98 rpm (24.97 Hz), 68% CI 1495.68-1500.28 rpm, p_map 0.985, 15/18 peaks explained, line 49.94 Hz. Alternative 749.88 rpm p=0.015. No display_rpm for independent check. Video fps 30.0, Nyquist 15.0 Hz with near_nyquist_warning=true: 24.97 Hz 1x is above Nyquist, so reported orders 1x/2x/3x = 0.0 mm/s must not be read as absent shaft vibration.

title: Amplitudes uncalibrated — no ISO 20816 severity can be reported
summary: scale_calibrated=false and overall iso_zone=null. Channel mm/s RMS values are physically implausible as absolute levels, so channel ISO D labels are not reported. Amplitudes are relative only. On relative RMS, trailer frame is highest, ~1.75x generator enclosure and ~2.17x exhaust stack. Conclusions restricted to frequencies, orders, phase and ratios.

title: Structural modes 2.46–6.68 Hz identified; no resonance evidence at operating speed
summary: FDD structural modes: 2.46 Hz zeta 5.13% sv_ratio 3.92, phases -20.6/0/-17.6 deg; 3.28 Hz zeta 6.38% sv_ratio 6.07, phases -44.6/0/-78.3 deg; 4.10 Hz zeta 3.07% sv_ratio 10.45, phases -142.1/0/-77.0 deg; 6.68 Hz zeta 2.38% sv_ratio 13.68, phases 34.9/0/27.4 deg across enclosure/trailer/exhaust. Residual peak 2.34 +/-0.23 Hz corroborates lowest mode. Campbell criticals=[] and resonance posterior 0.030 (prior 0.12, -6.5 dB, 0 criticals in swept range) — no order-line crossing shown.

title: Evaluable fault hypotheses show no positive fault evidence
summary: Combustion imbalance p=0.015 vs prior 0.10, evidence -8.7 dB, 0.5-order/firing-order ratio 0.055. Resonance p=0.030 vs prior 0.12, -6.5 dB. Looseness p=0.080 unchanged from prior 0.08, 5 shaft harmonics, 0.0 dB (neutral). Cavitation index 0.069, HF energy fraction 0.017, HF kurtosis -0.019, audio cavitation_like=false and rubbing_or_impacts=false; this is a genset, not a pump, and cavitation fault is evaluable=false.

title: Imbalance, misalignment and other shaft faults not evaluable from this capture
summary: Fault posterior evaluable=false for imbalance (p=0.15 = prior), misalignment (0.10), flow (0.10), cavitation (0.08), bearing (0.08) and rotor_bar (0.05); these probabilities are priors only, not diagnoses. Missing evidence is consistent with 1x at 24.97 Hz being above the 15.0 Hz Nyquist. Need a better capture: accelerometer + tachometer, or video sampling well above 50 Hz for 1x and higher for harmonics, with calibrated displacement/velocity scale, cross-coupling phase for misalignment, and nameplate cylinders/poles/rpm (currently blank/0).

title: Fixed-speed synchronous genset — speed-setpoint optimisation not applicable
summary: Operation is steady after start: audio speed_changing=steady, 0:28-0:33 crank/start transient then 0:33-end steady loaded operation at constant RPM. Speed 1497.98 rpm is locked to measured line 49.94 Hz in a synchronous genset; changing rpm would change electrical frequency. There is no variable-speed flow duty, Campbell criticals=[], and resonance posterior is low at 0.030. Therefore run_optimiser/propose_setpoint are not invoked and no new rpm is proposed.

text:
## Assessment

- **Machine/speed:** Synchronous 4-stroke genset operating at **1,497.98 rpm (24.97 Hz)**. Speed-posterior probability is **0.985**, with a 68% interval of **1,475–1,500 rpm actually 1,495.68–1,500.28 rpm**. Measured line frequency is **49.94 Hz**, consistent with synchronous operation.
- **Capture limitation:** Video Nyquist is only **15.0 Hz**, below the **24.97 Hz shaft frequency**. Therefore, 1×/2×/3× order results cannot be used to assess imbalance, misalignment, bearing defects or rotor-bar faults.
- **Calibration:** Amplitude scale is **uncalibrated**; therefore, no ISO 20816 zone or absolute mm/s severity is reported. Relative vibration is highest at the **trailer frame**, approximately **1.75× the generator enclosure** and **2.17× the exhaust stack**.
- **Structural modes identified:** **2.46 Hz (ζ=5.13%)**, **3.28 Hz (ζ=6.38%)**, **4.10 Hz (ζ=3.07%)**, and **6.68 Hz (ζ=2.38%)**. No Campbell critical speeds were identified in the operating range.
- **Fault evidence:** Resonance probability is low at **0.030** versus a 0.12 prior. Combustion-imbalance probability is **0.015** versus a 0.10 prior. Looseness remains at its **0.080 prior** with neutral evidence. Cavitation index is **0.069**, with no corroborating cavitation or impact sounds; cavitation is also not applicable as a pump-fault conclusion for this genset.
- **Not evaluable:** Imbalance, misalignment, flow excitation, bearing defect and rotor-bar fault remain at prior probabilities because the required shaft-order evidence is unavailable.

## Optimisation decision

No speed-setpoint change is proposed. This is a **fixed-frequency synchronous genset**, and operation after the start transient is steady at constant RPM. Changing speed would alter the **49.94 Hz electrical frequency**. Accordingly, the variable-speed optimiser and setpoint proposal were not invoked.

## Required follow-up capture

Use a calibrated accelerometer with a tachometer reference, sampled sufficiently above **249.7 Hz** to capture shaft harmonics through 10×, plus cross-coupling phase measurements for misalignment assessment.
